name: delorean
description: DeLorean — Claude-driven scheduling, quoting and billing hub for The Refinery

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npx --prefix web tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && npx --prefix web tsc -b web
